raw.rationale: AMG-232 (navtemadlin) is a potent, selective MDM2 inhibitor that reactivates p53; PRISM single-agent screens show selective killing largely restricted to TP53 wild-type lineages with intact p53 signaling, especially liposarcoma, some leukemias, and subsets of solid tumors, while most lineages lack selective sensitivity at 2.5 µM. Given low base rates and the requirement for lineage-level mean log2FC ≤ -0.5 and ≥0.5 below other lines, only a few p53-wild-type-enriched lineages have modestly elevated probabilities.
